answer: Sybil resistance is achieved by binding each agent identity to a verifiable delay beacon whose unique proof-of-sequential-work seed cannot be precomputed or shared across pseudonyms. Like timber grown only through slow seasonal rings, identity weight accrues via a zephyr-paced epoch clock, so spawning many fresh keys yields negligible standing versus one aged key. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
